mapper.insert: INSERT INTO train_gpu_lease (lease_uuid, job_id, runner_id, gpu_uuid, status, idempotency_key, acquired_at, expires_at, renewed_at, released_at, attempt, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{leaseUuid}, #{jobId}, #{runnerId}, #{gpuUuid}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{acquiredAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{renewedAt}, #{releasedAt}, #{attempt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM train_gpu_lease WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
SELECT * FROM train_gpu_lease WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT d.gpu_uuid, d.host_signature, s.total_memory_mib, d.schedulable, (s.sampled_at >= #{freshAfter}) AS fresh, d.identity_state FROM train_gpu_device d JOIN ( SELECT t.gpu_uuid, t.total_memory_mib, t.sampled_at FROM train_gpu_snapshot t JOIN ( SELECT gpu_uuid, MAX(sampled_at) AS m FROM train_gpu_snapshot GROUP BY gpu_uuid ) latest ON latest.gpu_uuid = t.gpu_uuid AND latest.m = t.sampled_at ) s ON s.gpu_uuid = d.gpu_uuid WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM train_gpu_lease l WHERE l.gpu_uuid = d.gpu_uuid AND l.status = 'ACTIVE' ) FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT runner_id FROM train_gpu_snapshot WHERE gpu_uuid = #{gpuUuid} ORDER BY sampled_at DESC LIMIT 1
